'''May 2003 Rochester, Minnesota tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament held on Saturday 17 May 2003 at Face the Music in Rochester, Minnesota. [[Peter Jacobson]] ran the six-game tournament, which drew 12 players and opened the Minnesota "Road to States" series ahead of the [[2003 Minnesota State Championship]]. 140 packs of prize support went to 10 players. [[Alex Richetta]] won and also collected a $5.00 cash bounty on [[Joshua Grace|Josh Grace]].<ref name="pcf-1291-26390">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=26390#26390 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 May 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
